origins.section: A catch Clause Catches Its Type and Every Subtype
An Exception Thrown in a catch Block Replaces the One Being Handled
The Stack Trace Is Recorded Where the Exception Is Created, Not Where It Is Thrown
Throwing Costs Microseconds, Mostly the Stack Trace; a try That Doesn't Throw Costs Nothing

gates.says: all 4 of this quiz's answerable readings held and each was taken over the question as it stands

recorded.prompt:q-cyclic-graph-render: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-cyclic-graph-render: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-cyclic-graph-render: Page decides c. Lines 38-39: "StackOverflowError and OutOfMemoryError extend Error, not Exception, so catch (Exception) lets them pass." Reference table row catch (Exception e): lets through Errors.
recorded.prompt:q-audit-in-catch: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-audit-in-catch: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-audit-in-catch: Page decides c. Lines 113-114: "Java doesn't link a new exception to the one being handled, which only the variable e refers to; when the catch block throws, e is dropped." Output line 110 shows "suppressed: 0, cause: null". Section heading: an exception thrown in a catch block replaces the one being handled. The page's example throws from a call in the catch block (mirror.read), the same shape as audit.record.
recorded.prompt:q-shared-refilled: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-shared-refilled: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-shared-refilled: Page decides c. Lines 169-171: "Calling fillInStackTrace() on the shared object before each throw walks the stack anyway, and overwrites the trace of an earlier failure still queued for the log." Line 167: fillInStackTrace records the current stack.
recorded.prompt:q-remove-try-blocks: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-remove-try-blocks: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-remove-try-blocks: Page decides a. Lines 196-197: "A try adds no instruction: javac writes an exception table that the JVM reads only when something is thrown, so valid input costs what checking first does." Summary line 221: a try that doesn't throw costs nothing. Its says overstates slightly: the page compares valid input with check-first (6 ns vs 5 ns), not with the same code without a try.

recorded.pass:q-cyclic-graph-render:a: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-cyclic-graph-render:a: Refuted by lines 38-39 (StackOverflowError extends Error, not Exception) and the Reference table.
recorded.prompt:q-cyclic-graph-render:b: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-cyclic-graph-render:b: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-cyclic-graph-render:b: Refuted by line 31: "catch (X e) takes an X or any subclass of X", plus lines 38-39 that Errors pass catch (Exception).
recorded.prompt:q-cyclic-graph-render:d: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-cyclic-graph-render:d: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-cyclic-graph-render:d: Refuted by lines 39-40: "catch (Throwable) takes them, and the thread runs on", and the Reference table row for catch (Throwable). Partly true: its outcome (a StackOverflowError reaches the caller) is correct; only the reason is wrong. Its says ("the type decides, not the state of the stack") goes slightly past the page, which never discusses stack state, though it follows from catch (Throwable) taking it.
recorded.prompt:q-audit-in-catch:a: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-audit-in-catch:a: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-audit-in-catch:a: Refuted by implication: lines 113-114 and output line 110 show only the exception thrown in the catch block reaching the caller. The page never states outright that statements after the throwing call do not run (basic control flow), so this rests on inference.
recorded.prompt:q-audit-in-catch:b: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-audit-in-catch:b: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-audit-in-catch:b: Refuted by line 113 ("Java doesn't link a new exception to the one being handled"), output line 110 ("suppressed: 0"), and lines 117-124 where addSuppressed must be called explicitly. Lines 141-143 note try-with-resources does attach suppressed automatically, a possible source of the distractor's appeal, but that is not this code.
recorded.prompt:q-audit-in-catch:d: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-audit-in-catch:d: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-audit-in-catch:d: Refuted by line 110 ("cause: null") and line 113. Its says ("the cause is set only by whoever creates the exception") overstates the page: the page only shows the cause passed to the constructor (lines 55-56) and never says that is the only way (initCause exists).
